summary: REJECT at 2 blockers and 1 SHOULD-FIX. It also correctly keeps OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING, OBL-JOIN-FX-AUTHORING, OBL-FC-C1, and OBL-BLK-1..4 as leftover-design; keeps DR-114 OPEN; says D-056 gates 2 and 3 do not hold; executes no fixtures; forces no G09 ride; and authorizes no implementation. Second, d056AuthoringIneligibleReasonStale.actorJoinRemainsDesign and .unnamedJoinFxExecutionOwner still say join execution remains unnamed, its proposed G32 owner is not live, and G32 is not recordable until G31 is live; live file 08 has one G31 row and one G32 row, and D-169 expressly closed that unnamed-leftover measurement. Third, the remeasurement clause still names predecessor v7, naming v1, and three-limb v1 and ends with a D-167 disclaimer instead of stating the direct v8 / naming-v2 / three-limb-v2 / D-169 successor custody. All 62 recorded inputs, 64 unique path-and-digest assertions, both HEAD fields, the frozen v8 digest, file 08, and COORD otherwise reproduce exactly; no fixture bytes are present or invented.
